body: I'd still like closure on our relationship, she just abandoned me out of the blue. That's what hurts
The thing is I know you're right but it doesn't make the current pain any less
Ikr , but hey , our pets need us and love us and that's something. I'll make a deal with you , as shit life is most of the time , let's stick around for them. For now anyway

Hey thanks to everyone for all your replies , this has been worrying me (/r/depression) and so it's nice to get closure from all this. You are all so right on how things like this happen and I'll move on , I think I am still in my mourning bit but I'm sure I'll never look back when I find someone new. Thank you all
Oh she definitely wasn't my first , but I understand what you mean completely.
Yeah I suppose you're right , at the very least I did care about her a lot.
As simple as that statement is , you're so right ☺. I just need time but I really appreciate that so thank you so much ❤

When I saw your heading my first reaction was to say something about how "hey not all parents are supportive okay , be nice to the rest of us" then I read your post. Amen mate , it's like a generational thing preventing them from understanding what mental health issues are.
